summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo, without running any code or committing. Files: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); clickable_ranges added to UnderlineBar, which now yields one Text object with click spans last; Opacity now combines the blended color into the existing style so metadata is kept; new docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py plus a new tests/test_tabs.py. Existing tests were not modified. The layout resolver is unchanged because it already supports size, min_size, and fraction. Deviations: Escape calls self.app.set_focus(None) unawaited, because App has no focus method; the bar position is mapped from full-list index to displayed-tab label ranges so duplicate names underline the correct tab. Nothing was executed, so all tests are unverified.
